spans.text: Lee... They've all calmed down.
Right, thanks.
...Still, I can tell they're getting more and more anxious.
I just checked – the rain is also getting heavier.
We need to think of something.
Lee Enfield remains silent and kneels down by the wall to get a closer look at PK's body.
Miss Lee?
Tokarev expresses her bewilderment, but Lee Enfield simply stands up again and observes her surroundings quietly.
...Miss Lee?
Just call me Lee, Tokarev.
Do you remember how MDR was killed?
Uh...sure, Lee.
I do remember. Miss MDR's neural cloud crashed as she was attacked electronically in a completely sealed room.
There's something I haven't been able to figure out.
Why did MDR enter that room in the first place?
And why would MDR, who specializes in electronic warfare, fall victim to an electronic attack herself?
Don't tell me even you believe it was a ghost.
It would be a relief if it really were a ghost.
No ghost can imagine what kind of hardships we've been through.
Sadly, I am 100% certain that we are not in a fantasy story, but a third-rate detective novel.
I don't understand. What do you mean?
We've already confirmed multiple times that there's no one else in the building.
If this is a third-rate detective novel, do you mean to say the culprit is among us?
But how is that possible?
The truth is often hidden in shadows where the light can't reach, Tokarev.
The only possible reason for MDR to be ambushed that way is because she trusted the culprit enough to turn her back.
I've found someone to be very suspicious for a while now.
Do you remember the scuffle we got into in the beginning? And what happened when we discovered MDR's body?
You mean...
Leader, how long are we supposed to wait?!
Apart from the two team leaders, the remaining T-Dolls are starting to lose their cool.
The consecutive deaths of their friends have greatly infuriated them, but not being able to identify the murderer is also making them uneasy.
The ominous sense of impending doom spreads among them like a miasma. Everyone is waiting for things to blow up any second.
Type 56-1, Gr G36c, Papasha, Sten.
Yes, ma'am.
Let's start from the beginning.
After my last communication with Gr G36c, why did you leave your post, Sten?
...I was wrong to do that, and I've already told you why I did it.
I found it impossible to be a sitting duck, and my anxiety got the better of me.
So I decided to walk it off and take a look around.
Gr G36c said PK went after you, but you never saw her, is that true?
Of course! I don't know what's going on, but I honestly didn't see her!
...Wait, the way you're questioning me... You think I did it?
Not at all. Lee is merely trying to sort out the facts.
...I received your call not long after I left.
Just as I was trying to figure out who snitched on me, I heard Papasha's scream. My ears are still ringing a bit even now.
Papasha, when you and Type 56-1 discovered PK, was she already lying on the floor?
Papasha?
Oh! Uh...da.
Sorry...I'm still in shock...
Tovarisch 56-1 and I were conducting an outward search according to plan but didn't find anything remarkable, so we went back the way we came.
Then...then I saw PK collapsed right here.
What she said.
Sten got here soon, and then the two of you.
...Well, Leader?
Who do you think is responsible for this – a ghost or one of us?
Don't make such nasty jokes...
I'd rather believe it's a ghost, to be honest.
No matter the circumstances, accusing someone of killing a fellow T-Doll is pretty serious, you know?
Papasha found PK and screamed.
Sten, who was not too far away, heard the scream and rushed to the scene.
Sten, did you hear anything odd?
Answer me first!
Sten!
...No, I didn't! I didn't hear anything but the rain and the thunder!
The mounting suspicion is causing the already heavy atmosphere to sour rapidly.

Tokarev glances again at Lee Enfield, who appears to be deep in thought. She has absolute faith in her, but given the circumstance, if Lee still can't think of a solution, things will soon go completely out of hand.
MDR fell victim to an electronic assault, while PK was shot.
Hmm?
Multiple bullet wounds can be found on PK's body.
Her cause of death is most definitely a gunshot.
This is different than the case with MDR.
...Now that you mention it, you're absolutely right. I was too overwhelmed to even consider that.
But what does it mean?
Everything happens for a reason, Tokarev.
Putting this together with my previous suspicions, I now have a general idea of what happened.
This is also why I said we're in nothing more than a third-rate detective novel.
A mysterious mansion, some terrifying rumors, a cliched thunderstorm... I have nothing against classics, but sometimes I wish authors can be just a little more original.
You're speaking in a completely different tone.
Are you sure you have the answer?
I don't know what they say about me on the anonymous forum, but I'm not as simple as they think.
I do, in fact, have a rough understanding of the situation at hand. The culprit thinks they've already done a pretty good job, but we Griffin T-Dolls can do even better.
But I'm still missing one last piece of the puzzle. Would you help me, Tokarev?
Certainly. It would be my pleasure.
